description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Engineering e Service - Amendment No. 07
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the service minute for the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, specifically addressing recruitment procedures, qualifications, age limits, and examination processes for public service positions. It deals with public sector recruitment regulations and service conditions, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public service administration and recruitment matters rather than government structure/personnel changes.
